verdict.rationale: Runloop documents devbox tunnels for reaching ports on a devbox over a simple URL (runloop-docs-5, runloop-docs-33). A dedicated tutorial shows starting an app and sharing a live preview link in pull requests (runloop-docs-54), and the SDK guidance lists tunnels as a core capability (runloop-docs-29). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documented detail on public-vs-authenticated access, URL format and multi-port handling.
